messages:
rachel: quick sync for the release post + webinar. need a single canonical changelog and final docs permalink. can eng confirm rollout window?
max: aiming for 2026-11-02 15:00 UTC canary, 15:20 full. no infra conflicts.
ben: webinar at 16:00 UTC, landing page live at 15:40. marketing needs docs link by 15:10 to lock CTAs and slides.
max: changelog to use (please paste verbatim in announcement header):
```
RWD-Infer v3.0.0 (2026-11-02)
- Unified batching engine for heterogeneous workloads (improves throughput and tail latency)
- INT4 and INT8 optimized kernels for popular GPU families
- Faster KV warmup and deterministic resume behavior
- Multiple stability and security fixes
```
rachel: great. marketing also wants a short, customer-friendly rollback line to include.
max: publish: "If regressions are detected, we automatically roll back to rwd-infer-2.x with traffic cutover in minutes." ops will validate the exact SLA.
ops-oncall: will run canary probes at t+0 and t+5m and post status to #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: created #deploy-2065432100-canary  will post hooks and health outputs.
ashley: docs preview up at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/preview/3-0-0. I'll publish final permalink at 14:55 UTC: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/rwd-infer-3.0.0
rachel: inbound lead routing: registrants should be tagged release-nov02 and routed to SDR-Intl. sdr-bot, confirm webhook fields?
sdr-bot: set campaign=nov02-release, source=webinar-cta, tag=release-nov02. assigning to SDR-Intl and posting mapping to #integrations.
ben: marketing blurb: "improved throughput and tail latency on mixed workloads"  eng prefer qualifier?
max: use: "up to 30% throughput improvement and reduced tail latency on our mixed workload benchmark."
rachel: final checklist:
- max: confirm deploy window (done)
- ashley: publish docs permalink (pending)
- sdr-bot: webhook mapping (done)
- ops-oncall: run probes at canary (pending)
- rachel: send announcement T-10m and update webinar CTA T-5m
max: I'll post a T-30 and T-5 note to the canary channel. standby for immediate rollback if smoke checks fail.
rachel: scheduling a 14:30 UTC preflight call for last-minute checks. ping here for any changes. :thumbsup:
